MP Launches Chief Minister's Accessible Transport Service

Madhya Pradesh will launch the Chief Minister's Accessible Transport Service on September 25. Chief Minister Mohan will flag off 351 buses from Bhopal to mark the commencement of the service, which will operate in various locations across the state.
